credit.statement: GIRAUDEAU'S READINGS OF TOLKIEN, NOT TOLKIEN'S TEXT. The archive holds PE17 only as a 221-page image-only scan, machine-read on 30 July 2026; the OCR delivered the English commentary and lost the Elvish orthography — 9.1% of accented forms survived against 59.1% of plain ones. This dataset exists because 78% of PE17's accented forms are attested in no other volume the archive holds, so nothing on the shelf can vouch for their spelling and an in-place repair of the OCR cannot reach them. Giraudeau's index can: he is a second human transcription of the same printed pages and supplies both the spelling and the page. Where this index and a readable PE17 ever disagree, THE VOLUME WINS. Nothing here may be quoted as Tolkien's words; it tells a reader what form to look for and on which page.
